div.div: صَمَارَى , (M, O, K,) and صُمَارَى, (O, K,) and ↓ صُمَارِىٌّ , (S, O, K,) and صِمَارى, with kesr, [but whether otherwise like the first and second or the last, is not shown,] (TA, from Az,) The podex, or the anus; syn. دُبُرٌ, (S,) or اِسْتٌ, (M, A,) or سَافِلَةٌ: (O:) because of its foul smell. (O, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
